floor_notes: M, 6/7/5, 5+1 files. But cases 2 and 3 contradict: in case 2 no cached row mentions 'sbx-1', which is exactly case 3's 'unknown scope -> invalidate' fallback, so a build satisfying case 3 refetches in case 2 - and the card's headline (a sandbox session churns the Brain chain) is precisely the unknown-run case, so the stated fallback leaves it unfixed. console-brain-page A also edits invalidation.ts (adds ledger.summary) - sequence them.

reason: Sound move, but the irrelevance proof as written contradicts its own headline case.
